aboutGame.title: What is WonderPaws Wiki?
paragraphs: WonderPaws Wiki is a fan-built guide hub for WonderPaws, a cozy life simulation set in the bright streets of Paw City. Players create a character, move into a first home, share the neighborhood with animal roommates, and explore a colorful world built around cute companions.

Our guides cover the systems players meet in their first hours, from character creation and home decoration to careers, multiplayer visits, and the animal transformation feature that lets you live as a Paw Pal. Everything is organized so you can find clear, practical answers fast.

faq.title: WonderPaws Wiki FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about WonderPaws Wiki and the game.

items.question: What is WonderPaws Wiki?
items.answer: WonderPaws Wiki is a fan-built guide hub for WonderPaws, a cozy life simulation set in Paw City where players create a character, decorate a home, and live alongside animal companions.

items.question: Is WonderPaws Wiki an official site?
items.answer: No. WonderPaws Wiki is an unofficial fan resource made by players, and it is not affiliated with the WonderPaws developers.

items.question: Which guide should I read first on WonderPaws Wiki?
items.answer: Start with the WonderPaws Wiki Beginner Guide, then branch into companions, home decoration, and animal transformation as you get comfortable.

items.question: Does WonderPaws Wiki cover multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. The WonderPaws Wiki multiplayer guide explains co-op sessions, visiting friends' homes, and shared city events.

items.question: How often is WonderPaws Wiki updated?
items.answer: WonderPaws Wiki is updated as new guides and game details arrive, so check the latest articles for fresh information.
